parameters.query:
WITH bumped AS (
  INSERT INTO invoice_counter (year, last_nr)
  SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NOW())::INTEGER, 1
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM orders
    WHERE order_id = '{{$json.body.order_id}}'
      AND (invoice_number IS NULL OR invoice_number = '')
  )
  ON CONFLICT (year) DO UPDATE SET last_nr = invoice_counter.last_nr + 1
  RETURNING year::TEXT || '-' || LPAD(last_nr::TEXT, 4, '0') AS new_invoice_number
)
UPDATE orders
SET invoice_number = (SELECT new_invoice_number FROM bumped)
WHERE order_id = '{{$json.body.order_id}}'
  AND (invoice_number IS NULL OR invoice_number = '')
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bumped);

SELECT
  o.order_id,
  o.order_date,
  o.buyer_name,
  o.buyer_street,
  o.buyer_city,
  o.buyer_zip,
  o.buyer_country,
  o.items_json,
  o.subtotal,
  o.shipping_cost,
  o.total,
  o.currency,
  o.invoice_number,
  o.tracking_number,
  o.carrier
FROM orders AS o
WHERE order_id = '{{$('Webhook: Order-ID empfangen').item.json.body.order_id}}'
LIMIT 1;
